data.title: Income tax prepayments from 2026
data.summary: The Finanzamt Musterhafen has set your income tax prepayments (Einkommensteuer-Vorauszahlungen) at €420.00 per quarter from 2026. The notice is dated 22 December 2025.
data.explanation: This notice sets how much income tax you pay in advance each quarter from 2026: €420.00 on 10 March, 10 June, 10 September and 10 December. Make sure these payments are made on time, for example with a standing order. If you disagree with the amount, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the Finanzamt. The app shows until when. If you don't object, the notice becomes final. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
